title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcement + regional circuit-breaker backoff during failover
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Context: During a regional capacity incident on 2026-02-14 we observed repeated SLO regressions after automatic regional failover. Root cause analysis showed the regional circuit-breaker backoff did not increase conservatively across multi-region failover, which allowed cascading request retries into the new region and caused transient overload. Additionally, SLO enforcement (slowpath/drop thresholds) had a tolerance window that was too permissive for failover scenarios. Motivation: prevent repeat regressions by (1) tightening SLO enforcement decision boundaries, (2) implementing exponential backoff and jitter on regional circuit-breaker transitions, and (3) applying earlier, opt-out load-shedding in cross-region failover paths as a temporary safety net. This is a hotfix intended to be low-risk and revertible.

What I changed (high level):
- service/slo/enforcer.go: tightened enforcement thresholds, reduced sliding-window aggregation from 60s to 30s during failover mode, and exposed a feature flag `slo_failover_mode`.
- service/traffic/circuit_breaker.go: added exponential backoff + capped jitter when enabling a region-level CB after failover; ensure backoff state persists for the failover session.
- service/traffic/failover_controller.go: detect multi-region failover and enable conservative shedding policy earlier in the request path.
- telemetry/metrics: added metrics `slo.enforcer.failover_mode_active`, `cb.regional.backoff_seconds`, and an alert rule tweak to reduce noise but surface repeated backoffs.
- e2e and integration tests: new test harness scenarios for simulated multi-region failover and load to validate no cascading retries.
- config: feature flag default ON for hotfix rollout; safe rollback path documented.

Testing done:
- unit tests: added and updated (all passing locally and CI).
- integration tests: canary integration run against staging multi-region cluster (capacity-sim), passed.
- e2e: simulated failover under load; validated SLO and that request queues do not grow in the destination region.
- manual verification: smoke test routes served correctly with no increased 5xx after rollout to staging.

Rollout plan:
1) Deploy to staging and run failover-sim (already done).
2) Roll out to low-traffic region with feature flag OFF by default; enable `slo_failover_mode` for 10% of traffic for 15 minutes.
3) Monitor `slo.*` and `cb.*` metrics, then enable globally in hosted for short-window (1hr) burst if stable.
4) If any regressions, toggle feature flag off and revert via hotfix revert branch (documented).

Notes:
- This change is intentionally conservative: thresholds tightened only during `failover_mode` and can be toggled without code revert.
- Not a permanent policy; follow-up ENG-8291 will propose longer-term circuit-breaker strategy.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] Integration tests
- [x] E2E failover simulation
- [x] Metrics added
- [x] Rollout plan documented
